TERMS & RISK NOTICE

Research support, not financial advice.

Effective 7 October 2026

Important: RippleMap does not provide investment, legal, tax, or trading advice. Market data and AI output may be delayed, incomplete, or wrong. Never trade solely from a RippleMap result.

Use of the service

RippleMap helps users examine live market observations, recent source leads, and conditional AI-generated hypotheses. You are responsible for verifying all information and deciding whether any action is appropriate.

No execution or custody

RippleMap does not hold customer funds, connect to trading accounts, execute orders, promise returns, or recommend personalized transactions. References to assets or directions are analytical descriptions, not solicitations.

AI and source limitations

Generated analysis can contain mistakes or unsupported inference. Article titles are discovery leads rather than independently verified facts. Correlation and timing do not establish causation. Prices can change after a snapshot is collected.

Acceptable use

You must not abuse, disrupt, scrape excessively, reverse engineer security controls, or use the service unlawfully. Automated and high-volume access may be restricted.

Public links

When you create a public share link, you authorize read-only public access to that investigation. You are responsible for the content you publish and may delete the underlying record to remove access.

Availability and liability

The service is provided “as is” without guarantees of uptime, accuracy, fitness, or profitability. To the fullest extent permitted by law, the maintainer is not liable for trading losses, missed opportunities, or decisions based on the service.

Changes

These terms may evolve as RippleMap develops. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
